name: The second push: lanes, a desk, and an audit by a second harness

lanes.name: Ryan's Mac, Claude Code
lanes.account: the account signed in on the Mac

people.name: Ryan
people.role: Owner. Starts each lane, answers on the review desk, carries the prompts between the two harnesses, merges what is big.

sessions.name: Driver
sessions.role: Writes each lane's brief, reads its work, merges what is small and safe, keeps the review desk

sessions.name: Audit lane
sessions.role: Checks every claim against its evidence, writes the handoff for Codex, reconciles what comes back

sessions.name: Building lanes
sessions.role: Site, agents and chat, evidence: one slice each, on a branch and in a worktree of its own

sessions.name: Codex target lane
sessions.role: Builds the Codex compile target and runs one template in Codex

sessions.name: Auditor
sessions.role: Reads the claims and a snapshot of the repository as a skeptic. Writes a handback. Changes nothing
